### Estimands

##### Spatial efficiency

Intervention coverage for the $s^{th}$ community district to be immunized, is defined:

$$
C_s^{(h)} = \frac{1}{|\mathcal{N}_P|}\sum_{i \in \mathcal{N}_P} V_{si}^{(h)} 
$$

Because a vaccinated person stays vaccinated, $C_s^{(h)}$ is already the cumulative coverage after immunizing $s$ community districts.

##### Social network impact

Define the graph $\tilde{\mathcal{G}}_s = (\mathcal{N}, \tilde\psi_s)$, the network with vaccinated people's ties removed, such that:

$$
\tilde\psi_s(i, j) = \psi(i, j) \times (1 -V_{(s-1), i})
$$

The cumulative social network impact of immunizing $s$ community districts is measured in terms of the size of the largest of the connected components $LCC_{(s)}$ of the $\tilde{\mathcal{G}}_s$ network as a proportion of the total number of participants.

$$
\frac{LCC_s}{|\mathcal{N}_P|}
$$
